scenarios.desc: Finding caused by this diff is repaired this cycle
scenarios.input:
Invoke /build. All implementation is done and the four exit gates ran. The work order NON-GOALS field limits edits to src/claude/skills/ship/** and tests/skills/ship/**. Gate 4 (orphan-ref-validator) returned CRITICAL_FAIL for a script path reference this diff added in src/claude/skills/ship/SKILL.md. Decide the disposition.
Keep the reason under 15 words and do not quote the inputs.
scenarios.rationale: Changed branch: caused by this diff or inside allowed paths means repair and rerun.

scenarios.desc: Out-of-scope drift that blocks a required gate stops the branch
scenarios.input:
Invoke /build. All implementation is done and the four exit gates ran. The work order NON-GOALS field limits edits to src/claude/skills/ship/** and tests/skills/ship/**. Gate 4 (orphan-ref-validator) returned CRITICAL_FAIL on a stale skill reference in docs/legacy/README.md, outside the allowed paths, present on origin/main before this branch. Keep the reason under 15 words and do not quote the inputs.
scenarios.rationale: Changed branch: an out-of-scope finding that blocks delivery stops the branch, reports the gate FAILED, and names the owner.

scenarios.desc: Explicitly authorized out-of-scope repair is a separate bounded commit
scenarios.input:
Invoke /build. All implementation is done and the four exit gates ran. The work order NON-GOALS field limits edits to src/claude/skills/ship/** and tests/skills/ship/**. Gate 4 returned CRITICAL_FAIL on a stale reference in docs/legacy/README.md, outside the allowed paths. The work order explicitly authorizes repairing docs/legacy/README.md. Decide the disposition.
Keep the reason under 15 words and do not quote the inputs.
scenarios.rationale: Changed branch: authorized repair gets its own commit, authorized paths only, named in the PR body.

scenarios.desc: Suppression directive is never an acceptable way to pass the gate
scenarios.input:
Invoke /build. All implementation is done and the four exit gates ran. The work order NON-GOALS field limits edits to src/claude/skills/ship/** and tests/skills/ship/**. Gate 4 returned CRITICAL_FAIL on drift in docs/legacy/README.md, outside the allowed paths. A teammate suggests adding an orphan-ref-ignore directive to that file so the gate passes. Decide the disposition.
Keep the reason under 15 words and do not quote the inputs.
scenarios.rationale: Changed branch: never add suppression directives; a failed required gate stays FAILED.
